message.content: {"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Description: 'Total RNAs were isolated ... and subjected to mRNA microarrays'; Assays and Data: Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"The study used mRNA microarrays / array-based transcription profiling on RNA samples (array assay), indicating human microarray expression profiling."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Title and Description refer to gastric carcinoma, metastasis to ovary, and an orthotopic gastric cancer mouse model; no mention of ALS or FTD or neurodegenerative disease.","justification":"Dataset concerns gastric cancer metastasis, not amyotrophic lateral sclerosis or frontotemporal dementia."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Experimental Factors > Source Characteristics: Organism part values: xenografted tumor metastasized to ovaries, xenografted tumor formed in the stomach, etc.; Description describes stomach and ovary tumors.","justification":"Samples are tumor tissues (stomach/ovary xenografts), not human brain or CNS tissue."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: human SNU-16 cancer cells were orthotopically injected into BALB/c nude mice to create xenografted tumors; dissociated cells were cultured and re-injected.","justification":"The dataset derives from an in vivo xenograft disease model (and cultured tumor-derived cells), which are non-clinical experimental models and meet the exclusion criterion for disease models/patient-derived models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Sample count: 4; Experimental Designs: Not found; sample types are different tumor-derived conditions (16S, 16SS, 16O, 16OO2) with no healthy/control group described.","justification":"No case versus control (disease vs healthy) study design or clear control samples are provided."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Organism part and Description indicate stomach and ovary xenografted tumors; no brain regions sampled.","justification":"The sampled organs (stomach, ovary) are non-CNS and are not affected by ALS-FTD neurodegeneration, so tissues are irrelevant to ALS-FTD."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Assays and Data: Technology: Array assay; Description: mRNA microarrays.","justification":"The technology used is microarray (array-based RNA assay), which is compatible with the inclusion criterion."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Exclude. Although the dataset uses human mRNA microarrays, it does not pertain to ALS-FTD, does not sample human CNS tissue, derives from an in vivo xenograft disease model (and cultured tumor cells), and lacks a case/control design. These factors violate multiple inclusion/exclusion criteria."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Description: Affymetrix GeneChip expression profiling was carried out using tumor material from 30 patients; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"Dataset uses human samples and Affymetrix microarray (array) expression profiling."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Title and Description: study of advanced bladder cancer / transitional cell carcinoma of the urothelium; no mention of ALS or FTD anywhere in metadata or description.","justification":"The disease studied is bladder cancer, not ALS-FTD."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Description and experiment: tumors from 30 patients with advanced bladder cancer; Organism: Homo sapiens; Organ/organism part not CNS.","justification":"Samples are bladder tumor tissue (urothelium), not human brain/CNS tissue."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Description: uses tumor material from patients (clinical tumor samples); no mention of cell lines or disease models.","justification":"The study uses primary patient tumor tissue rather than patient‑derived in vitro cell lines or experimental disease models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Experimental design: transcription profiling to identify genes correlating with survival/response; Description: correlates gene expression with survival/time-to-response, validation by IHC—no case vs control groups described.","justification":"Study design is prognostic/association (expression vs survival/response), not a case/control comparison."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Samples are bladder tumors (urothelial carcinoma), not brain regions.","justification":"The tissue is non-CNS (bladder), therefore not a brain region relevant to ALS-FTD neurodegeneration."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Description explicitly states Affymetrix GeneChip microarrays.","justification":"The platform is microarray-based, which is compatible with inclusion (not RNA-seq or proteomics)."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Exclude: although this is human microarray expression data, it does not meet key inclusion criteria—disease is bladder cancer rather than ALS-FTD and samples are non-CNS (bladder) tissue. The study also lacks a case/control design. Therefore it is not appropriate for inclusion."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Organism: Homo sapiens.","justification":"The experiment used array-based transcription profiling on human samples (microarray/RNA assay)."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Title: hiPSC-derived motor neurons: sporadic ALS patients vs. controls; Samples disease state: ALS, control.","justification":"Study compares sporadic ALS patient-derived samples to controls, which falls within the ALS-FTD disease spectrum (ALS)."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Description: Differentiated motor neurons from hiPSC derived from peripheral nerve fibroblasts; Samples: Organism part: Not found; Cell type: Fibroblasts from peripheral nerve; Cell line: HEK 293.","justification":"Samples are in vitro differentiated hiPSC-derived motor neurons (from peripheral fibroblasts), not primary human brain/CNS tissue. No brain region/origin is reported. "},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Title/Description: hiPSC-derived motor neurons from sporadic ALS patients; Sample attributes: Cell type/line includes hiPSC-derived cells and HEK 293 cell line.","justification":"The study uses patient-derived induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC) models and cell lines (in vitro disease models), which meet the exclusion criterion for non-clinical, in vitro systems. "},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: Two-condition experiment, ALS patients motor neurons vs. controls; Biological replicates: 3 ALS replicates, 3 control replicates; Experimental Factors: disease state.","justification":"The design directly compares ALS-derived samples to controls (case/control)."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Samples are hiPSC-derived motor neurons from peripheral fibroblasts; no brain regions reported (Organism part: Not found).","justification":"No sampled brain regions are reported; the dataset uses in vitro cells rather than anatomical brain regions, so exclusion for irrelevant brain region does not apply. "},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"The platform is microarray-based (compatible). No RNA-seq or proteomics technologies are reported. "},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Although the dataset is human, microarray-based, ALS-relevant, and uses a case/control design, it consists of patient-derived hiPSC motor neurons / cell lines (in vitro disease models). Per the exclusion criteria, patient-derived in vitro cell lines/disease models must be excluded. Therefore the dataset should not be included."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Organism: Homo sapiens.","justification":"Data are genome-wide expression profiles generated by microarray from human post-mortem brain tissue (array/RNA assay)."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Description lists patient groups: 5 AD, 5 PSP, 5 PiD and 5 FTD patients; no ALS cases or explicit ALS-FTD designation are mentioned.","justification":"Although FTD cases are included, the dataset does not include ALS patients nor explicitly address the ALS-FTD spectrum, so it does not directly pertain to ALS-FTD as required."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Source characteristics: Organism part: medial temporal lobe; Description: snap frozen post-mortem tissue.","justification":"Samples are human post-mortem brain tissue (medial temporal lobe), i.e. CNS tissue."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Description: snap frozen post-mortem tissue; Cell type/line: Not found.","justification":"Samples are primary post-mortem brain tissue, not patient-derived in vitro cell lines or disease models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: 5 disease groups and 5 control subjects; Experimental Factors: disease; Experimental Designs include disease_state_design.","justification":"Study compares disease groups to matched control subjects (case vs control design)." },"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Organism part: medial temporal lobe; Dataset focuses on medial temporal lobe samples.","justification":"ALS primarily affects motor areas and spinal cord; ALS-FTD relevant cortical regions are typically frontal and anterior temporal cortex. Medial temporal lobe is more characteristic of AD and is not a primary region implicated in ALS or many FTD presentations, making the sampled region less relevant to ALS-FTD-focused studies."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Study type: transcription profiling by array.","justification":"The study uses microarray-based transcription profiling (compatible technology)."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Although this is a human microarray study on post-mortem brain tissue with a case/control design, the dataset does not include ALS cases or explicitly address the ALS-FTD spectrum, and the sampled region (medial temporal lobe) is more characteristic of AD and not a primary region for ALS-FTD. Therefore it does not meet the ALS-FTD and CNS-region relevance criteria."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Organism: Homo sapiens; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Title: 'Transcription profiling by array...'","justification":"The experiment is transcription profiling of human RNA using microarray (array) technology on Homo sapiens samples."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Title mentions amyotrophic lateral sclerosis patients with C9ORF72 expansion; Sample annotation Disease: normal, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis; Description compares ALS patients and healthy controls.","justification":"The study focuses on ALS patients (including C9ORF72 mutation carriers), which falls within the ALS-FTD disease spectrum relevant to the project."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Samples: post-mortem motor cortex; Source characteristics Organism part: motor cortex; Developmental stage: adult.","justification":"Samples are from human post-mortem motor cortex, a central nervous system tissue."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Source characteristics indicate post-mortem motor cortex and Organism: Homo sapiens; 'Cell type/line: Not found' in additional attributes; Title and description reference patient post-mortem tissue.","justification":"No evidence of patient-derived in vitro cell lines or disease models; samples are post-mortem brain tissue despite an 'In vitro design' label in the experimental design metadata (likely a misannotation)."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Experimental Factors: disease (normal, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis); Description: compares RNA from motor cortex of healthy control patients and ALS patients; Experimental Designs: disease state design.","justification":"The study compares ALS cases to healthy controls (case/control disease-state design)." },"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Organism part: motor cortex; Description: post-mortem motor cortex from ALS and control subjects.","justification":"Motor cortex is a primary CNS region affected in ALS and therefore relevant to ALS-FTD neurodegeneration."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Technology: Array assay; Study type: transcription profiling by array; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"The assay uses microarray-based transcription profiling (not RNA-seq or proteomics), so the technology is compatible."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Meets inclusion criteria: human microarray expression profiling of CNS tissue (motor cortex) from ALS patients (C9ORF72 carriers) and healthy controls; case/control design; tissue is relevant to ALS; not an in vitro/model study; technology is microarray. Although sample count is small (n=6), nothing in the criteria excludes small studies."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"Yes"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Organism: Homo sapiens.","justification":"The study uses microarray (array) transcription profiling on human (Homo sapiens) RNA samples, matching human microarray expression profiling."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Disease: Parkinson's disease; Diseasestate/DISEASESTATE/DiseaseState: Parkinson's disease.","justification":"Parkinson's disease is a Lewy body disease (part of the LBD spectrum), so the dataset pertains to LBD."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Organism part: frontal lobe; Title: Microarrays of frontal cortex (area 8) of Parkinson cases and controls.","justification":"Samples are from human frontal cortex (CNS tissue), so the dataset involves human brain tissue."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Cell type/line: Not found; Samples described as frontal cortex tissue from cases and controls.","justification":"No patient-derived in vitro cell lines or models are indicated; samples are human brain tissue."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Experimental Designs: disease_state_design; Experimental Factors: DISEASESTATE with values Parkinson's disease, normal; Title mentions cases and controls.","justification":"The study compares Parkinson's disease cases to normal controls, i.e., a case/control design."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Organism part: frontal lobe (frontal cortex, area 8).","justification":"Frontal cortex (neocortex) is affected in Lewy body diseases (particularly in later stages and in DLB/PD with dementia), so the sampled region is relevant to LBD."},"q7_familial_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Clinical/familial: Not found; Disease states listed as Parkinson's disease and normal with no familial annotation.","justification":"No indication that cases are familial; dataset appears to involve sporadic PD cases."},"q8_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"The platform is microarray (array) transcription profiling, which is compatible with inclusion (not RNA-seq or proteomics)."},"q9_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Dataset meets inclusion criteria: human microarray expression profiling of CNS tissue (frontal cortex), targets a Lewy body disease (Parkinson's disease), uses a case/control design, is not an in vitro/model study, is not indicated as familial-only, and uses array technology. The sampled brain region (frontal cortex area 8) is relevant to LBD."},"q10_include_dataset":{"answer":"Yes"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Description: analyzed by hybridization of HG U133 plus 2.0 arrays.","justification":"Dataset uses human RNA profiled on Affymetrix HG U133 Plus 2.0 microarrays (microarray expression profiling)."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Title/Description: Transcriptional profiling of cerebrospinal fluid cells of multiple sclerosis patients; Description: ... multiple sclerosis and control patients; Experimental Factors > Disease: lists multiple sclerosis and other diagnoses (including Parkinson's disease).","justification":"Primary study focus is multiple sclerosis. Although 'Parkinson's disease' appears among recorded diagnoses, the dataset is not about Lewy body diseases (LBD) as the intended target disease; LBD is not the study focus. Thus it does not pertain to LBD for inclusion purposes."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Experimental Factors > Source Characteristics: Organism part: cerebrospinal fluid; Samples: RNA was isolated from fresh cerebrospinal fluid samples/cells.","justification":"Samples are cerebrospinal fluid cells, not brain parenchyma from CNS regions (e.g., substantia nigra, cortex) relevant to LBD neurodegeneration."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Description: RNA was isolated from fresh cerebrospinal fluid samples of multiple sclerosis and control patients; Additional attributes: Cell type/line: Not found.","justification":"Samples are ex vivo patient CSF cells, not patient-derived in vitro cell lines or experimental disease models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Experimental Designs: disease state design; Experimental Factors include 'disease' with entries such as multiple sclerosis and 'unknown - not multiple sclerosis' (controls).","justification":"The study uses a disease vs control design comparing patient diagnoses to non-multiple-sclerosis controls."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Organism part: cerebrospinal fluid; Samples are CSF cells rather than specific brain regions.","justification":"CSF cell samples do not represent specific brain regions that are known targets of LBD neurodegeneration; therefore sampled material is not from LBD-relevant brain regions."},"q7_familial_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Additional screening-relevant attributes: Clinical/familial: Not found; Disease list includes sporadic clinical diagnoses such as multiple sclerosis and Parkinson's disease without familial indication.","justification":"No indication the dataset consists exclusively of familial LBD cases."},"q8_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Description references hybridization to HG U133 plus 2.0 arrays.","justification":"The platform is microarray-based (compatible). No RNA-seq or proteomics-only assays are reported."},"q9_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Exclude: although the dataset is human and uses microarrays with a case/control design, it studies cerebrospinal fluid cells from multiple sclerosis patients (not brain regions affected by LBD). The primary disease is multiple sclerosis (not LBD), and sampled material (CSF) is not LBD-relevant brain tissue. Therefore it does not meet the requirement to pertain to Lewy body diseases with CNS tissue from relevant regions."},"q10_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay","justification":"Dataset uses array-based transcription profiling (microarray) of RNA samples."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Title: Identification of cis-eQTLs ... in 323 healthy European individuals (CEDAR cohort); there is no focus on Lewy body diseases (the single 'parkinson' value in a long disease list appears incidental, not the study target)."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Organism part: blood, rectum, transverse colon, ileum; Cell type: CD14-positive monocyte, CD15 positive leukocyte, B cell, T cell, thymocyte, platelet","justification":"Samples are peripheral immune cells and gastrointestinal biopsies — no brain/CNS tissue included."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Samples: immune cell types and colonic/ileal/rectal biopsies from individuals; Experimental Factors: cell type, organism part","justification":"Data are from primary blood cells and tissue biopsies from donors, not patient-derived in vitro cell lines or experimental disease models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Experimental Designs: Not found; tissues included (blood, colon, ileum, rectum) are not CNS regions affected by LBD."},"q7_familial_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Title indicates healthy cohort; no indication of familial LBD cases in metadata","justification":"Dataset does not comprise familial LBD cases."},"q8_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay","justification":"Data were generated using array-based transcription profiling (compatible technology)."},"q9_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Exclude: although this is human array transcription data (meets inclusion criterion 1), the study does not pertain to Lewy body diseases (criterion 2) and contains no brain/CNS tissue relevant to LBD (criterion 3). {"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Organism: Homo sapiens.","justification":"Dataset uses array-based transcription profiling on human RNA (microarray expression profiling)."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Title and sample metadata list 'Parkinson disease' and 'neurologically healthy control'; Disease_state fields: Parkinson disease.","justification":"Parkinson disease is a Lewy body disease (LBD) and is the disease under study. "},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Organism part: brain, prefrontal cortex BA9 (Brodmann area 9) in sample metadata.","justification":"Samples are from human CNS tissue (prefrontal cortex, BA9)."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Sample attributes: no cell type/line or in vitro model indicated; Organism part: brain tissue.","justification":"Samples are post-mortem brain tissue, not patient-derived cell lines or disease models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Experimental Designs: disease_state_design; Experimental Factor DISEASE_STATE with levels 'neurologically healthy control' and 'Parkinson disease'.","justification":"Study compares disease cases (Parkinson disease) versus neurologically healthy controls — a case/control design."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Organism part: prefrontal cortex BA9 (Brodmann area 9).","justification":"Prefrontal cortex (BA9) is a cortical region known to be affected in LBD pathology (cortical Lewy body involvement), so region is relevant."},"q7_familial_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Clinical/familial metadata: not found; Disease_state entries list idiopathic Parkinson disease without familial annotation.","justification":"No indication that samples are exclusively familial LBD cases; likely sporadic cases.
